title.en: Liu Yuxi in a Qing portrait album

alt.en: Liu Yuxi sits in a chair on the right; his biography fills the facing left page.
alt.zh: 右页刘禹锡坐于椅中，左页为传记文字。

caption.en: Qing-dynasty commemorative portrait of the Tang poet Liu Yuxi, with its facing biography retained.
caption.zh: 清代绘唐代诗人刘禹锡纪念像，保留对页传记。

interpretation.en: The portrait and facing biography frame Liu Yuxi as a poet worth remembering in Qing China.
interpretation.zh: 肖像与对页传记呈现清代对刘禹锡这位唐代诗人的追忆。

caption.en: Wang Shouren’s landscape, dated 1506 in the museum catalog. His inscription specifies the seventh day of the first lunar month.
caption.zh: 王守仁山水，馆藏定年1506；自题为丙寅正月初七。

interpretation.en: The philosopher also practiced painting and calligraphy. The museum identifies Ni Zan’s influence in this quiet composition, expanding the biography beyond Wang’s teaching and public career.
interpretation.zh: 这位思想家亦从事书画；馆方指出宁静构图受到倪瓒影响，使其生平不止于讲学与政治活动。

title.en: A congratulatory album on the Jinchuan campaign

alt.en: Vertical calligraphy occupies the first photographed opening, framed by golden dragons.
alt.zh: 首幅馆方摄影中，纵列书法由金色龙纹边框围绕。

caption.en: Opening of a Qing court congratulatory album on completing the campaigns against Greater and Lesser Jinchuan. Exact production year is unrecorded.
caption.zh: 清代祝贺平定大小金川颂册开篇；确切制作年未载。

interpretation.en: The heading explicitly announces completion of the two Jinchuan campaigns. Its formal praise records the court’s celebration of military success and should be read as a partisan voice.
interpretation.zh: 题首明确写“平定两金川大功告成”；颂词记录宫廷如何庆祝战事，应作为具有立场的当时声音阅读。

title.en: Gao Shi among seven imagined Tang travelers

alt.en: Seven labeled scholars travel on mounts; Gao Shi is the rear figure at the right, above Cui Hao.
alt.zh: 七位具名文士骑乘出行；高适在右后方、崔颢上方。

caption.en: Ding Guanpeng’s Qing painting after a work attributed to Han Huang, with Wang Youdun’s colophon dated 1748. Gao Shi is labeled at the right rear.
caption.zh: 丁观鹏临传韩滉《七贤过关图》，附汪由敦1748年题记；高适题名位于右后方。

interpretation.en: The label identifies Gao Shi, the poet in the Fengqiu officeholding story. This imagined assembly of Tang scholars shows his later reputation, not an actual shared journey or the county appointment.
interpretation.zh: 题名明确辨识封丘任职故事中的高适；唐代文士的想象聚会表现后世声望，并非真实同行或县尉任命场景。

title.en: The ritual conch sent with Fuk’anggan to Taiwan

alt.en: A white conch with gilded, jewel-set fittings lies horizontally beside its museum label.
alt.zh: 白色法螺横置，饰以鎏金嵌宝配件，下方为馆藏标签。

caption.en: Qianlong-period conch. Its box label records dispatch with Fuk’anggan to Taiwan in 1787 and return to the court in 1788.
caption.zh: 乾隆时期法螺，原匣签记1787年随福康安赴台、1788年缴回宫廷。

interpretation.en: The box inscription traces this conch from imperial ritual to Fuk’anggan’s Taiwan voyage and back to court.
interpretation.zh: 原匣题记串起这件法螺从宫廷仪式、随福康安渡海赴台，到返回宫廷的经历。

title.en: Wang Yangming’s Record of the Shrine to Xiang

alt.en: The opening lines of the cursive text appear beside silk mounting and red collector seals.
alt.zh: 草书正文开篇与绫裱、朱色鉴藏印并列。

caption.en: Museum-photographed opening section of Wang Shouren’s Record of the Shrine to Xiang. The manuscript itself is undated.
caption.zh: 王守仁《象祠记》正文开篇的馆方分段摄影；此书迹未纪年。

interpretation.en: The text responds to a local An chief’s rebuilding of a shrine and discusses moral transformation. It offers a Ming scholar’s voice within negotiations between hereditary local authority and imperial cultural ideals.
interpretation.zh: 文字回应安氏宣慰重修祠宇，并讨论教化；在世袭地方权力与帝国文化理想的互动中，留下明代士人的声音。

alt.en: Women sit and stand around fabric on a platform; one holds scissors before a landscape screen.

caption.en: Official section photograph from Mou Yi’s 1240 handscroll, interpreting Xie Huilian’s older poem through Tang-style figures preparing clothes.

interpretation.zh: 剪刀、布料与共同工作空间，把这幅诗意图景同纺织故事中的成衣工序联系起来。

title.en: Qianlong’s Ten Complete Victories in woven silk

alt.en: Woven calligraphy, collector seals and part of the large heading occupy a mounted scroll section.
alt.zh: 装裱卷段包含缂织文字、鉴藏印及大字引首的一部分。

caption.en: Official photographed section 3 of a Qing kesi textile reproducing Qianlong’s Ten Complete Victories text of 1792. Textile manufacture is not separately dated.
caption.zh: 清代缂丝乾隆《十全记》的馆方第3段摄影；所摹文字为1792年，织造年代未另载。

interpretation.en: Imperial writing became a costly crafted object. The textile connects Qianlong’s collecting and commissioning to the presentation of his military record as perfect achievement, a claim made by the emperor.
interpretation.zh: 御书化为精制织物，将乾隆的收藏与委托制作同“十全武功”的自我表述联系起来；“十全”是皇帝自身的主张。

caption.en: Edict dated 1384, the twenty-third day of the intercalary tenth lunar month, concerning household taxation and local administrators.
caption.zh: 1384年农历闰十月二十三日谕旨，涉及户口税粮与地方官员。

interpretation.en: The founder addresses how revenue instructions reach local offices and taxpayers. This surviving administrative text adds an imperial voice to the biography’s discussion of Ming institutions.
interpretation.zh: 开国皇帝讨论税粮指令如何传至地方官府与纳税户；留存政务文本为其传记中的明初制度提供御前声音。

title.en: A Ming order on southwestern military supplies

alt.en: Red vertical writing spans a large paper sheet with interlinear corrections and an identifying heading.
alt.zh: 大幅纸页上为朱笔纵书，带行间修改及题首标识。

caption.en: Military order dated 1388, second lunar month, day 10. It discusses southwestern local chiefs, troops and grain shortages.
caption.zh: 1388年农历二月初十军务谕旨，涉及西南土官、军队与缺粮。

interpretation.en: The text names local chiefs and explicitly discusses supplying troops. It gives the regional tusi framework a concrete administrative document showing the uneven practical demands of imperial rule.
interpretation.zh: 文本点名土官并明确讨论军粮，为土司制度框架提供具体政务文书，展示帝国统治在实际资源与义务上的不均衡。

creator.zh: 洪武朝廷；收入明太祖御笔册

institution.zh: 国立故宫博物院，台北；中書000015N000000021

context.en: The portrait and facing biography frame Liu Yuxi as a poet worth remembering in Qing China.
context.zh: 肖像与对页传记呈现清代对刘禹锡这位唐代诗人的追忆。

context.en: The philosopher also practiced painting and calligraphy. The museum identifies Ni Zan’s influence in this quiet composition, expanding the biography beyond Wang’s teaching and public career.
context.zh: 这位思想家亦从事书画；馆方指出宁静构图受到倪瓒影响，使其生平不止于讲学与政治活动。

context.en: The heading explicitly announces completion of the two Jinchuan campaigns. Its formal praise records the court’s celebration of military success and should be read as a partisan voice.
context.zh: 题首明确写“平定两金川大功告成”；颂词记录宫廷如何庆祝战事，应作为具有立场的当时声音阅读。

context.en: The label identifies Gao Shi, the poet in the Fengqiu officeholding story. This imagined assembly of Tang scholars shows his later reputation, not an actual shared journey or the county appointment.
context.zh: 题名明确辨识封丘任职故事中的高适；唐代文士的想象聚会表现后世声望，并非真实同行或县尉任命场景。

context.en: The box inscription traces this conch from imperial ritual to Fuk’anggan’s Taiwan voyage and back to court.
context.zh: 原匣题记串起这件法螺从宫廷仪式、随福康安渡海赴台，到返回宫廷的经历。

context.en: Buildings, trays and workers organize silk production into household spaces. Follow how the painter connects separate tasks.
context.zh: 建筑、器具与劳动者把蚕织生产安排在家庭空间中。观察画家如何连接不同工序。

context.en: This is one of the inscribed ritual vessels central to the Zhou entry’s account of offices and political authority. The exterior photograph shows the vessel’s form; the inscription is transcribed on the linked museum page.
context.zh: 此器正是周代条目所述通过铭文记述官职与政治权力的礼器实例；外观照片展示器形，馆藏链接提供铭文内容。

context.en: The emperor shares sacrificial meat with Xu Da after praying for crops. This direct address presents the sovereign–commander relationship through a ritual gift.
context.zh: 皇帝祈谷后与徐达分享祭肉；直接称名的敕书，通过礼仪馈赠呈现君臣关系。

context.en: Metal cash remained important alongside paper instruments. This surviving Song coin supplies a contemporary material comparison for the entry’s discussion of moving, paying and representing monetary value.
context.zh: 金属钱与纸面凭券并存；这枚宋钱为条目所述货币运输、支付与价值表达提供当时实物参照。

context.en: The text responds to a local An chief’s rebuilding of a shrine and discusses moral transformation. It offers a Ming scholar’s voice within negotiations between hereditary local authority and imperial cultural ideals.
context.zh: 文字回应安氏宣慰重修祠宇，并讨论教化；在世袭地方权力与帝国文化理想的互动中，留下明代士人的声音。

context.en: The text responds to a local An chief’s rebuilding of a shrine and discusses moral transformation. It offers a Ming scholar’s voice within negotiations between hereditary local authority and imperial cultural ideals.

context.en: Scissors, fabric and a shared workspace connect this poetic scene to the textile story’s stages of garment making.
context.zh: 剪刀、布料与共同工作空间，把这幅诗意图景同纺织故事中的成衣工序联系起来。

context.en: Imperial writing became a costly crafted object. The textile connects Qianlong’s collecting and commissioning to the presentation of his military record as perfect achievement, a claim made by the emperor.
context.zh: 御书化为精制织物，将乾隆的收藏与委托制作同“十全武功”的自我表述联系起来；“十全”是皇帝自身的主张。

context.en: The solitary rider carries Jinchuan victory news through a mountainous landscape. The painting makes the movement of military information its subject.
context.zh: 独骑在山地传递金川捷报；画卷以军事消息的流动为观看焦点。
